status: Brochure specification; individual assets and decorative choices are illustrative.

specifications.appliesTo: Living, dining, family lounge, all bedrooms and kitchen
Reception, waiting lounge, ground-floor lift lobby and corridor
specifications.description: Large-format vitrified tile. Typical-floor lift lobby and corridor use vitrified tile.
Kitchen is provided for a modular installation. Glazed vitrified tiles extend to the washroom and powder-room false ceiling.
Water purifier, sink, dishwasher, washing machine, instant geyser and hot/cold water provisions.

Kohler, Grohe or equivalent fittings. Granite counter and countertop basin, concealed diverter, overhead and hand shower, bath spout, wall-mounted WC with concealed tank. Master washroom has a shower partition. Paper holder, calcium-silicate board grid ceiling and provision for instant geyser.
Eight-foot-high teak frame, designer veneered shutter, PU polish and 4-in-1 digital lock.
Eight-foot-high hardwood frame with PU-polished veneered shutter.
Hardwood frame, exterior veneer and interior laminate.
Aluminium or uPVC sliding deck doors with toughened glass and bug screen. Windows use aluminium or uPVC, toughened glazing and bug screens. Ventilators follow the façade design.
Laminated glass balcony railing. Common stairs use MS railing.

Textured exterior paint with exterior emulsion. Acrylic emulsion unit walls and acrylic economy emulsion unit ceilings. Common walls and ceilings use emulsion; typical lift-side walls use vitrified tile cladding. Basement walls and ceilings use cement or emulsion paint.

Eleven kW for 3-bed and 3-bed + study. Thirteen kW for 4-bed. Legrand, Schneider, Panasonic or equivalent modular switches. Brochure marks 100% DG backup to common areas and apartments at additional cost.
High-speed elevators, common-area CCTV, digital main-door lock, gas leak detection and common EV charge points.
